body: Definitely on of the best Bangla movies. Those who like to watch a thriller movie with unique story can go for watching this. You will enjoy every minute with excitement. Arefin Shuvo, ABM Sumon's looks are really great! And lastly, the role of the Taskeen Rahman(Jisan)was really very well.

It debuted as Dipankar Dipon as a film director. This movie made the action films of Bangladesh on another level. "Dhaka Attack" delivers what Bangladesh's film audience have been craving for far too long.

At first, there was a attack on a chemical factory and they steal some chemical. After that some dead body were found with some alphabets written on the body. It tells what is going to happen in the city.

If we talk about actors, Arifin Shuvu and ABM Sumon have done a great job in the movie. And the rest of the actors were good. Especially Taskeen Rahman. In my opinion, he is the next generation villain role of Bangladesh.

Really a superb- action-thriller film- specially on the context of Bangladesh. Intelligent plot, the overall execution and cinematography is also brilliant, music is heart-touching and catchy to ear.

In the acting section- protagonist Arefin Shuvoo and ABM Sumon- both heroes looked cool and charismatic as as detective officer and special force commander respectively. Other male characters- including Shatabdi Wadud, Shipon etc also did their best in their roles. But for the female characters- their character formation and acting was somehow just lame- specially Mahiya Mahi as crime journalist- she looked gorgeous (sometimes with excessive make-up!) but both her character and acting seemed a bit disappointing! If female heroines even in such male-dominated crime- thriller film can be presented as side-kicks or helping hands, it would be a lot more exciting I think! Ad placement also seemed tasteless. If such few inconsistencies here and there could be excluded, it would have become an almost-perfect film actually!

Yet- it's a marvelous film- in the second half you have to feel the real thrill- because the final adventuresome exploration begins and the new villain Taskeen Rahman comes to spotlight! In his debut film, he's done really awesome job as a cold-blooded, brutal serial killer. His background is also explored quite thoroughly in this film. So breaking the stereotype of typical Bengali cinema and bringing up a stylish anti-protagonist- it's just awesome and brilliant!And Taskeen Rahman deserves to get a best villain award!

My overall rating- 8/10

So this film is just ground-breaking by introducing stylish police- crime-action in Bangladeshi film industry. It's also getting super- duper hit in box office breaking some records- that also sounds cool and very promising. Conscious audience're rushing to movie theaters and wholeheartedly appreciating films, doing some constructive criticism- that's all we want! Kudos to debuted director Dipankar Dipan, story writer Sunny Sanwar and the whole team for their strenuous effort to bring up such a hi-fi movie and to value the high expectation of awaiting audience- hoping better for the future!And more and more promising directors are coming with their conceptual films, sounds like a golden era..so all the best, go ahead Bangla movie! :)

This movie is different from other movies made in Bangladesh.The script,cinematography,editing is worth for praising.Arfin Shuvo's Acting As AC Abid and ABM Sumon's acting was really good.There is thrill and good chemistry between Arfin Shuvo and Mahiya Mahi.I think this type of movie can bring back the old good movies era of Bangladesh.Definitely you should go to cinema halls to watch this movie.You'll never be disappointed.

Dhaka Attack is one of the best film of Bangladesh and also it was a good try. I have never seen such a movie before. The Story was the main hero of this film. The story is about Dhaka Metropolitan Police Elite Force fearless operation against an anonymous man who is very madly to destroy the country's defense layers and he is also most wanted from many foreign intelligence agencies. The three young officers are trying to stop him. They will success or not?. This is the plot.

We will talk about the positive things and the negative things.

So,Firstly we talk about the positive things. The performances are really good. Arifin shuvo,Shatabdi wadud,nawshaba,Alamgir,Afzal Hossain they are played very well. The main highlight of this film was ABM Sumon. ABM Sumon was outstanding. His SWAT attitude was very cool. And we also can't forget the performance of the villain. Taskeen Rahman was excellent. I have never seen such a villain Bangladeshi Cinema Before. His psycho behaviour and his brutality was also show that he was a pure devil. Just wow. I can't waiting for mission extreme and Operation Sundarban for see taskeen's villainous avatar. The music was very good. Specially Tup Tap. The melodious track by arijit singh and somlata. The editing and the bgm was very Good. The action was very realistic. Specially the bandarban sequence. The screenplay was very gripping. We want these types of movies.

And also we talk about the negative things. The only negative things of this film is the heroine. Mahiya mahi was the only disappointment of this film. Why she was in the film i don't understand. I hope she will be better in future.

Total rate of this cop-thriller film is 8/10.
